title: Hood up, Gully only
logline: The Legacy with its hood up in Gully's lot and Gully under it alone, from behind, October 2021, the pup between his boots. Nine years of Tuesdays. Where the other one is: the page doesn't go around the hood.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon with its hood up in a gravel lot, a heavy gray man bent under it from behind, a small three-legged dog sitting between his boots, no one else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon with its hood raised in a gravel lot with a heavy gray-haired man bent beneath it seen from behind and a small three-legged dog sitting between his boots, no one else, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
